channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Iran live updates: Tanker struck by projectile as US and Iran trade threats
item.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned on Sunday that an 'economic D-Day is coming for Iran.'

item.title: Sean Grayson, convicted in killing of Sonya Massey, dies in prison, attorney says
item.description: Grayson, 32, was convicted in October of second-degree murder for shooting Sonya Massey and was serving a 20-year sentence.

item.title: NYPD to investigate new video of people emerging from a sewer in NYC
item.description: Authorities are looking into the latest in a series of odd incidents in New York City involving people entering and exiting manholes in Manhattan.

item.title: Two Phoenix police officers fired and arrested after violent traffic stop
item.description: Two Phoenix police officers were dismissed and taken into custody following an unreported traffic stop where they allegedly assaulted a man and woman and used a Taser on them.
